title: Juyuanjian attenuates sarcopenia through dual regulation of the Akt/FoxO1 and SIRT1/PGC-1alpha pathways.
authors: Yan, Yibing; Liu, Xihong; Zhao, Peiyuan; Zhang, Xiaowei; Ma, Huifen; Cao, Bing; Yang, Peiyan; Gao, Gai; Xie, Zhishen; Zhang, Zhenqiang
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方Juyuanjian抗肌少症的作用机制，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Sarcopenia, an age-related degenerative disease, corresponds to "Qi Xu" syndrome in traditional Chinese medicine. Juyuanjian (JYJ), a classical Qi-tonifying formula, has shown potential against muscle atrophy and functional decline, but its molecular mechanisms are not well understood. PURPOSE: To investigate whether JYJ protects against sarcopenia and to elucidate its underlying mechanisms. STUDY DESIGN: Caenorhabditis elegans (C. elegans) RW1596, C2C12 myotube cells and senescence-accelerated mouse prone 8 (SAMP8) transgenic mice were used to explore the alleviative effect of JYJ on sarcopenia and the molecular mechanism in vivo and in vitro. METHODS: This study systematically evaluated the therapeutic effects of JYJ using multiple biological models. Ultra-high performance liquid chromatography-high-resolution mass spectrometry (UPLC-MS) was employed to characterize its chemical constituents, followed by network pharmacology to predict potential targets and pathways. These mechanisms were further validated through molecular biology experiments. Additionally, molecular docking and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations were conducted to elucidate the interactions and binding stability between key bioactive components and target proteins. RESULTS: JYJ significantly alleviated muscle fiber damage in C. elegans RW1596 and mitigated the decline in skeletal muscle mass and strength in SAMP8 mice. Furthermore, JYJ inhibited chronic low-grade inflammation by reducing tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha) and interleukin-6 (IL-6) levels, decreasing macrophage infiltration, and suppressing nuclear factor-kappa B (NF-kappaB) activation. Network pharmacology analysis indicated that mitochondrial biogenesis and proteasome-mediated ubiquitin-dependent processes were the main biological processes, with protein kinase B (Akt), forkhead box O1 (FoxO1), sirtuin 1 (SIRT1), and peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma coactivator 1-alpha (PGC-1alpha) as key targets. Consistent with this, JYJ enhanced the phosphorylation of Akt and FoxO1 both in vitro and in vivo, while downregulating the expression of muscle atrophy-related E3 ubiquitin ligases muscle ring finger 1 (MuRF1) and muscle atrophy F-box (MAFbx); it also upregulated the expression of SIRT1 and PGC-1alpha, promoting mitochondrial biogenesis and adenosine triphosphate (ATP) production. Molecular docking and 100-nanosecond MD simulations showed stable interactions between the bioactive components of JYJ and Akt/SIRT1, supported by favorable binding free energy and stable conformational dynamics. CONCLUSIONS: JYJ exerts anti-sarcopenic effects by dual regulation of protein degradation (Akt/FoxO1) and mitochondrial biogenesis (SIRT1/PGC-1alpha), providing a phytotherapeutic for sarcopenia.
abstract_zh: 背景：肌少症（Sarcopenia）是一种与年龄相关的退行性疾病，在中医中对应“气虚”证。举元煎（JYJ）作为一种经典的补气方剂，显示出对抗肌肉萎缩和功能衰退的潜力，但其分子机制尚不清楚。目的：探讨JYJ是否对肌少症具有保护作用，并阐明其潜在机制。研究设计：采用秀丽隐杆线虫（Caenorhabditis elegans, C. elegans）RW1596、C2C12肌管细胞和衰老加速小鼠易感8（SAMP8）转基因小鼠，在体内和体外探索JYJ对肌少症的缓解作用及其分子机制。方法：本研究利用多种生物模型系统评估了JYJ的治疗效果。采用超高效液相色谱-高分辨质谱（UPLC-MS）表征其化学成分，随后通过网络药理学预测潜在靶点和通路。这些机制通过分子生物学实验进一步验证。此外，进行了分子对接和分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟，以阐明关键生物活性成分与靶蛋白之间的相互作用和结合稳定性。结果：JYJ显著缓解了C. elegans RW1596的肌纤维损伤，并减轻了SAMP8小鼠骨骼肌质量和力量的下降。此外，JYJ通过降低肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-alpha）和白细胞介素-6（IL-6）水平、减少巨噬细胞浸润以及抑制核因子-κB（NF-kappaB）激活，抑制了慢性低度炎症。网络药理学分析表明，线粒体生物发生和蛋白酶体介导的泛素依赖性过程是主要生物过程，蛋白激酶B（Akt）、叉头框蛋白O1（FoxO1）、去乙酰化酶1（SIRT1）和过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ共激活因子1-α（PGC-1alpha）是关键靶点。与此一致，JYJ在体外和体内均增强了Akt和FoxO1的磷酸化，同时下调了肌肉萎缩相关E3泛素连接酶肌肉环指蛋白1（MuRF1）和肌肉萎缩F-box（MAFbx）的表达；它还上调了SIRT1和PGC-1alpha的表达，促进线粒体生物发生和三磷酸腺苷（ATP）产生。分子对接和100纳秒MD模拟显示，JYJ的生物活性成分与Akt/SIRT1之间存在稳定相互作用，并得到有利的结合自由能和稳定构象动力学的支持。结论：JYJ通过双重调节蛋白质降解（Akt/FoxO1）和线粒体生物发生（SIRT1/PGC-1alpha）发挥抗肌少症作用，为肌少症提供了一种植物疗法。
